teaser.en: The ribs of wooden dhows have been cut from this thorny little fruit tree.
teaser.sw: Mbavu za majahazi ya mbao zimekuwa zikichongwa kutoka kwa mti huu mdogo wa matunda wenye miiba.
teaser.dg: Mbavu za majahazi ga mbao zikakatwa kula muhi hinyu mdide wa matunda wenye miya.

summary.en: *Mukunazi* or *mkunazi* is the Indian jujube, a thorny shrub or small tree of villages and bush with small sweet-sour fruits. It also gives firewood, medicine and timber for the ribs of dhows.
summary.sw: *Mukunazi* au *mkunazi* ni mkunazi, kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba unaopatikana vijijini na porini, wenye matunda madogo yenye ladha ya utamu na uchachu. Pia hutoa kuni, dawa na mbao za kutengenezea mbavu za majahazi.
summary.dg: *Mukunazi* au *mkunazi* ni muhi wa *Indian jujube*, chichaka au muhi mdide wenye miya wa vidzidzini na weruni, wenye matunda madide ga mtswano na ngbwadu. Piya unalavya kuni, dawa na mbao za kuhenda mbavu za majahazi.

about.en:
*Mukunazi* is a thorny shrub or small tree with drooping, zigzag branches. The leaves are oval, shiny green above and paler and hairy beneath, with three clear veins running from the base. Pairs of small hooked thorns sit where the leaves join the twig.

The small flowers are greenish-yellow. The fruits are round and fleshy, turning from green to yellow or reddish-brown, with a sweet-sour taste around a hard stone.
about.sw:
*Mukunazi* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba, wenye matawi yanayoning'inia na kupinda kwa mtindo wa zigizaga. Majani yake yana umbo la yai, ni ya kijani kinachong'aa upande wa juu, na upande wa chini ni meupe kidogo na yenye vinyweleo, yakiwa na mishipa mitatu iliyo wazi inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani. Jozi za miiba midogo iliyopinda kama ndoano huota mahali majani yanapoungana na kitawi.

Maua yake madogo ni ya rangi ya kijani-manjano. Matunda ni ya mviringo na yenye nyama, hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi manjano au kahawia-nyekundu, na huwa na ladha ya utamu na uchachu inayozunguka kokwa gumu.
about.dg:
*Mukunazi* ni chichaka au muhi mdide wenye miya, wenye magongo ganagogbwadzika na ganagogaluka-galuka uphande. Makodza ni ga duara-ndefu, ga chijani ganang'arira dzulu, na photsi ni ga rangi ya kufifia na genye nyere, na gana mishipa mihahu inayotuluka sawa-sawa kula kotsi. Miya midide yenye umbo ra chiloo inamera jozi-jozi phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na chigongo.

Maruwa madide ni ga chijani na mandano. Matunda ni ga duara na genye nyama, ganagaluka kula chijani hadi mandano au rangi ya kundu na dongo, na ganakala na ladha ya mtswano na ngbwadu iriyozunguluka tembe ngumu.

where.en: It is found around villages and in the bush, often near homes where its fruit can be picked.
where.sw: Hupatikana karibu na vijiji na porini, mara nyingi karibu na makazi ambapo matunda yake yanaweza kuchumwa.
where.dg: Unaphahikana kanda-kanda ya vidzidzi na weruni, mara nyinji phephi na nyumba ambapho matundage ganaweza kuhundwa.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten. The wood is used for the ribs of dhows, the traditional sailing boats of the coast, and for firewood. The plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda huliwa. Mbao zake hutumika kutengenezea mbavu za majahazi, yaani vyombo vya jadi vya tanga vya pwani, na pia kama kuni. Mmea huu pia hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg: Matunda ganariwa. Mbao nkuhumirwa kuhenda mbavu za majahazi, madau ga tanga ga chienyeji ga pwani, na kuni. Mmea hinyu piya nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name as *mukunazi*; Pakia writes *mkunazi*. Giriama and Chonyi say *mukunazi*. Swahili calls the tree *mkunazi* and the fruit *kunazi*. In English it is jujube or Indian jujube.
names.sw: Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo kuwa *mukunazi*; Pakia anaandika *mkunazi*. Wagiriama na Wachonyi husema *mukunazi*. Kwa Kiswahili mti huitwa *mkunazi* na tunda lake *kunazi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *jujube* au *Indian jujube*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinalavya dzina ra Chidigo *mukunazi*; Pakia anaandika *mkunazi*. Kpwa Chigiriama na Chichonyi ni *mukunazi*. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi unaihwa *mkunazi* na tunda *kunazi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *jujube* au *Indian jujube*.
